metadata.legal_notice: PRELIMINARY BRAND STRATEGY / NOT LEGAL ADVICE — HUMAN / COUNSEL VERIFICATION REQUIRED

risks.evidence_rationale: Weak/crowded roots and possible descriptiveness.
risks.mitigation: Full search, registrability opinion, and filing strategy.

risks.evidence_rationale: Brazil register and local use are not cleared.
risks.mitigation: INPI and market search.

risks.evidence_rationale: Owners of related LORE or SHARD marks may object.
risks.mitigation: Similarity analysis and watch plan.

risks.evidence_rationale: Common-law or sector users may assert rights.
risks.mitigation: Common-law search and staged rollout.

risks.evidence_rationale: Unregistered use may not appear in registers.
risks.mitigation: Web, trade, marketplace, and entity search.

risks.evidence_rationale: Lore shard(s) is natural fantasy/game vocabulary.
risks.mitigation: Search variants and use strong source-identifying presentation.

risks.evidence_rationale: Adjacent apps may use related roots.
risks.mitigation: Software, app, company, and repository sweep.

risks.evidence_rationale: Shard is common in databases and distributed systems.
risks.mitigation: Never name generic units shards; claim the compound.

risks.evidence_rationale: Lore is common in culture and software.
risks.mitigation: Emphasize full compound and narrow claims.

risks.evidence_rationale: Sharding is prominent crypto vocabulary.
risks.mitigation: Avoid Web3 language, tokens, hexagons, and neon crypto cues.

risks.evidence_rationale: Mobile names have not been verified.
risks.mitigation: Search App Store and Google Play.

risks.evidence_rationale: GitHub, npm, PyPI, and Docker are unchecked.
risks.mitigation: Complete and document a sweep after authorization.

risks.evidence_rationale: Fantasy items and technical shards may dominate search.
risks.mitigation: Analyze search results and create a compound-first content plan.

risks.evidence_rationale: DNS, certificates, redirects, WHOIS, or email may disclose the brand.
risks.mitigation: Keep holdings private and monitor exposure.

risks.evidence_rationale: Handles are not recorded as secured.
risks.mitigation: Sweep major networks and define a fallback convention.

risks.evidence_rationale: English compound may vary in Brazilian speech.
risks.mitigation: Native-speaker testing and pronunciation guidance.

risks.evidence_rationale: Literal name can sound like an in-game item.
risks.mitigation: Use a professional descriptor and restrained design.

risks.evidence_rationale: Mythic tone may weaken seriousness.
risks.mitigation: Use Sage-Merchant voice and evidence proof.

risks.evidence_rationale: Collectible resonance may not transfer to every asset class.
risks.mitigation: Test architecture across planned categories.

risks.risk: Inability to enforce the mark broadly
risks.evidence_rationale: LORE and SHARD are weak/common independently.
risks.mitigation: Protect the compound and distinctive presentation.

risks.evidence_rationale: Internal usage can turn the root into a product noun.
risks.mitigation: Enforce usage doctrine in copy, schemas, and APIs.

risks.evidence_rationale: The brand is confidential and not cleared.
risks.mitigation: Use access controls and prohibit public materials.

risks.evidence_rationale: Renaming creates cost and leakage before approval.
risks.mitigation: Keep Phronesis and require the Gate 4 plan.

risks.evidence_rationale: Indexing creates legal and strategic exposure.
risks.mitigation: No page before Gates 1–5 and founder approval.

risks.risk: Internal/external naming confusion between Phronesis and LoreShard
risks.evidence_rationale: Dual identity can create inconsistent docs, support, or deployments.
risks.mitigation: Create explicit naming and migration maps.
